events.title: Golf: Mun Cuairt Alba
events.description: Le còrr air 550 raon-goilf tha Alba cliùiteach mar dhachaigh ghoilf. Tha an sreath 6-pàirt seo a’ gabhail turas air feadh na dùthcha gu na cùrsaichean ainmeil agus na seudan àlainn nach eil cho iomraiteach, a’ fosgladh ar sùilean gu goilf. Cluinnidh sinn bho ghoilfearan sean is òg, fireann is boireann, goilfearan dall is goilfearan ciorramach, agus bho chuid a bhios a' cosnadh beòshlaint à goilf. An t-seachdain-sa, tha sinn a’ leantainn goilfear proifeiseanta, Laura Murray, is i a’ trèanadh airson farpaisean an Tùr Eòrpach. Gabhaidh sinn sgrìob-adhair mu chuairt raointean-goilf ann am Fìobha, nam measg an Seann Chùrsa ann an Cill Rìmhinn far an deach riaghailtean ghoilf a’ stèidheachadh o chionn linntean, agus tha am Pro Scott Herald a’ cluiche an 17mh Road Hole dùbhlanach. Agus tha coidse proifeiseanta Keil Beveridge a’ toirt seachad comhairle na seachdaine airson dòigh-cluiche. Scotland has over 550 golf courses and is regarded worldwide as the home of golf. This series takes us on a journey around the country to explore the well-known courses as well as some of its hidden gems, and opens the door to golf. We hear from golfers young and old, male and female, blind and disabled players, and from those who make their living working in golf, plus we capture tips from professionals along the way. In this episode, we follow professional golfer Laura Murray through some of her training programme as she competes on the European Tour. We take an aerial journey across courses in Fife, including the Old Course in St Andrews where the rules of golf as we know them today were first established and where pro Scott Herald plays the infamous 17th Road Hole. Also, professional coach Keil Beveridge demonstrates his weekly top playing tip. Expert - Keil Beveridge Producer - Patricia Macleod Director - Scott Brown Executive Producer - Margaret Cameron.
